text:
jordan: T-30 for feature/x rollout — quick predeploy checklist and signoffs please.
lee: window still 20:30 PT? I'll run smoke.
sam: I'm deploying (sam -> deploy lead). Will start canary 1% -> 10% over 15m.
mica: Reviewing: CR LGTM, infra checks done, +1 for canary.
deploy-bot: CI build 4821 passed — all checks green. https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4821 :white_check_mark:
jordan: checklist:
- rollback owner: lee
- smoke owner: lee
- deploy owner: sam
- oncall: ops-oncall
- canary plan: 1% for 10m, 10% for 15m, 100% after metrics clear
- feature flag toggle: feature_x_v2 (start OFF, enable post-10% if metrics ok)
- db migrations: none (no schema changes)
- cache flush: front-cache flush after canary
lee: I have smoke playbook open. steps:
1) run smoke job: ./scripts/run_smoke.sh --env=prod --tag=feature/x
2) confirm latency < 120ms for p95
3) run sample prompts set: QA/featurex/smokeset.json
qa-bot: smoke set run stats (staging): failing_tests: 0, avg_p95: 86ms — note: prod will differ
mica: +approve for T-0.5 if smoke owner ready.
ops-oncall: I'm oncall window, will monitor rollback channels. set alert threshold: err_rate > 0.5% OR 5xx spike.
sam: during canary I'll watch token throughput and kv cache hit rate, will pause at any drift.
sam: deploy commands I'll run:
```bash
# create canary
rwdctl deploy --model feature/x:v2 --lane canary --percent 1 --notes "evening rollout"
# route traffic
rwdctl traffic shift --lane canary --percent 1
```
jordan: quick rollback steps (lee please keep ready):
```bash
rwdctl traffic shift --lane canary --percent 0
rwdctl deploy rollback --to-tag feature/x:v1.9.4
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingress-proxy -n prod
```
lee: acked, I have rollback tag pinned and db backups at 20:00 PT.
sam: going to start T-10 checks: health endpoints, low-latency probes, and token billing cap set to 10% of normal to avoid runaway.
jordan: any outstanding approvals? need one more +approve from product.
mica: pinging product in #product. @product could you ok the rollout for feature/x? (prod impact: minor)
product-person: mica: product ✅ — ok to proceed with canary.
sam: starting deploy in 5m. I'll post progress updates here. :rocket: 
deploy-bot: Deployment started by sam at 4976543230 — canary 1% created.
lee: smoke run started at 4976543240
lee: smoke OK — all endpoints returned 200 and p95 98ms. :thumbsup: 
sam: increasing to 10% now.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift to 10% complete at 4976543290
ops-oncall: Monitoring looks stable; no 5xx increase after 6m.
sam: moving to full rollout in 10m if metrics hold.
jordan: final signoffs captured: sam (deploy), lee (rollback/smoke), mica (prod approval), ops-oncall (monitor). Closing thread to tidy logs — drop a note if anything odd.
sam: thanks everyone — will paste final prod tag once complete.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 4976543350 — tag feature/x:v2-live
